title: SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA EDISON Co 8-K Filing — 2026-04-29
summary: Southern California Edison Company (SCE) and parent Edison International filed a Form 8-K on April 28, 2026, disclosing under Regulation FD that management will use a business update presentation (Exhibit 99.1) in meetings with institutional investors and at investor conferences. The filing does not contain the actual presentation content; it only references the exhibit and provides standard forward-looking statement disclaimers.
key_points: Form 8-K filed by Southern California Edison Company and Edison International on April 28, 2026

No substantive financial data, guidance, or operational updates are contained in this filing
